### Structure & Bond Price
The **Ho-Lee Model** models the short rate under the martingale measure
$\mathbb{Q}$ as
$$
dr_{t}=\Theta(t)dt+\sigma dW_{t}^\mathbb{Q}
$$
where $W_{t}^\mathbb{Q}$ is $\mathbb{Q}$-BM.
